prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Corrected production SIDE WALK reference atlas for the existing Bagseed game. Image 1 is the ACTUAL EXISTING STANDING CHARACTER BODY and is the absolute authority for fine line weight, crisp painted detail, torso width, hip width, hand size, shoe shape, cloth finish and body proportions. Match that existing illustrated art exactly, without thicker outlines, puffier bodies, larger fists, blurry paint, or a different cartoon style. Image 2 supplies ONLY motion landmarks. Generate EIGHT HEADLESS NECK-DOWN bodies, FOUR columns and TWO rows on a landscape 4:3 canvas. Top row STRICT RIGHT PROFILE, bottom row STRICT LEFT PROFILE. No three-quarter view. Four phases in each row: leading-foot contact; TRUE PASSING pose with one leg planted directly beneath the pelvis and the other knee bent/lifted; opposite-foot contact; opposite TRUE PASSING pose. Passing poses MUST bring the legs together under the body, NOT another wide split-leg stride. Arms swing gently opposite the legs and return near the sides on passing poses. Very subtle one-pixel body rise on passing poses. Keep the full transparent upper half of every cell empty, same reference scale and foot ground, bodies located in lower half; all heads completely absent. Replace the standing outfit with a fitted neutral-gray long-sleeve crew-neck underlayer, neutral-gray fitted trousers and neutral-gray stocking feet. Keep small natural tan #cf9670 hands. No hood, pouch or thick cuffs. The torso must stay as slim as the existing standing RIGHT/LEFT profile, about 20 of the 96 logical cell units wide; palms about 5 by 5, individual feet about 19 long. Copy landmark positions from image 2 but REMOVE every guide line, dot, label and baseline. Genuine transparent alpha, no shadows/background/text/grid. Keep all figures isolated. This is artwork for the existing standing model to move, NOT a new character design. Fine warm dark-brown ink rather than heavy black contour, clean restrained organic folds, same sharpness as image 1. Do not mirror the top row as a substitute for drawing the bottom row.
